answer: The prism counter is kept in wharf and kernel exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4550 identities would post 2463 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
